description.ja: 理論・導出・計算例を、分野ごとにまとめた読み物です。基礎から関連する手法と検証例へ進めます。
description.en: Read the theory, derivations and worked examples by field, from foundations to related methods and verification.

title.ja: 基礎・誤差・時間積分

description.ja: 誤差と安定性から入り、時間積分と拘束を持つ方程式の扱いをたどります。
description.en: Start with error and stability, then follow time integration and equations with constraints.

title.ja: 楕円型問題・線形代数・近似
title.en: Elliptic problems, linear algebra and approximation

description.ja: 境界値問題と疎行列の解法から、固有値・基底・補間・数値積分へ進みます。
description.en: Go from boundary-value problems and sparse solvers to eigenvalues, basis functions, interpolation and quadrature.

title.ja: 自動微分・最適化・逆問題

description.ja: 残差と解の微分を区別し、目的関数・観測・正則化へつなぎます。
description.en: Distinguish derivatives of residuals and solutions, then connect objectives, observations and regularization.

title.ja: 流体・衝撃波・定常解法

description.ja: 保存則の再構成、勾配制限、衝撃波の頑健性、低Mach数と定常反復の条件を読みます。
description.en: Read about reconstruction, limiting and shock robustness, followed by low-Mach conditions and steady iterations.

title.ja: 格子・有限要素・連成方程式
title.en: Meshes, finite elements and coupled equations

description.ja: 空間離散化と座標を整理し、非圧縮流・MHD・相対論系の条件へ進みます。
description.en: Organize spatial discretization and coordinates, then examine incompressible flow, MHD and relativistic systems.

description.ja: 粒子法、分布関数、長距離力と輸送方程式を読みます。
description.en: Explore particle methods, distribution functions, long-range forces and transport equations.

title.ja: 電磁場・静電場・電子状態
title.en: Electromagnetic fields, electrostatics and electronic structure

description.ja: 周期静電場・電磁場と、原子・分子・周期電子状態の近似をたどります。
description.en: Follow periodic electrostatics and electromagnetic fields, then atomic, molecular and periodic electronic-structure approximations.

title.ja: 確率計算・生物・温度制御
title.en: Stochastic computation, biology and temperature control

description.ja: 確率誤差、集団モデル、温度制御を、それぞれの検証量とともに比べます。
description.en: Compare stochastic error, population models and temperature control through their respective verification quantities.

title.ja: 検証問題・実験ガイド

description.ja: 計算対象と参照解を選び、展示・保存結果・実行例の役割を確認します。
description.en: Choose equations and references, and distinguish exhibits, saved results and runnable examples.

title.ja: 歴史・文献・整備記録

description.ja: 数値計算法の系譜と出典、教科書、収録範囲・整備記録を確認します。
description.en: Trace numerical methods and their sources, then consult textbooks, coverage and development records.
